correctness.rationale: For each n≥3, the distinct-third-edge definition yields exactly two cyclic exclusion rules: pendant selection forbids the next site and cycle-edge selection forbids the site after next. Flags recording current/next-site exclusions are forced by the preceding two masks; the four-state transfer trace is therefore a bijective count for every n, including n=3. Exact characteristic polynomial of the explicit matrix proves the quartic recurrence and rational series. Leading-term comparison in each residue modulo four proves the sharp floor(3n/4) size and all maximal counts. Standalone direct conflict enumeration checked every one of 349504 edge subsets for n=3,…,9, with exact independent SymPy certificates for four- and 16-state characteristic identities and degree/max multiplicity comparisons n=3,…,32. Finite tests are checks, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Edge-open packings are admissible injective edge-color classes, so their full cardinality profile is intrinsically motivated. The infinite family of sunlets is the canonical one-leaf unicyclic corona, outside tree-only maxima algorithms. The compact four-state trace/characteristic recurrence determines every coefficient for arbitrary order, and exact count of optimal packings significantly refines a mere scalar maximum. This is not an arbitrary fixed finite table, a trivial corollary of a previously stated family formula, or only relabeling a conflict graph.
